title.narrative: Voluntary medical project for treating children's tumors

description.narrative: 1- Building the capacity of doctors specialized in treating cancer patients. 2- Building the capacity of nurses specialized in caring for cancer patients. 3- Establishing diagnostic clinics in the specialty of pediatric oncology. 4- Establishing diagnostic clinics in the specialty of pediatric blood tumors. 5- Conducting training courses for medical staff in conjunction with the work of the clinics in order to raise the efficiency of local medical staff. 6- Building the capacity of pharmacists specialized in treating and caring for cancer patients.
Providing medical services to beneficiaries with limited income who cannot cover the costs of their treatment
